Select a company to view tasks.
No tasks match the current filters or se: No tasks match the current filters or search.
Choose the interface language. Agent-aut: Choose the interface language. Agent-authored content (comments, documents, questions) follows the same preference on the next run.
Local trusted mode is optimized for a lo: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
Authenticated public mode requires sign-: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
Authenticated private mode requires sign: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
Hide the username segment in home-direct: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
Configure how long automatic database ba: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
Control whether thumbs up and thumbs dow: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
No default is saved yet. The next thumbs: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
Keep voted AI outputs local only.
To retest the first-use prompt in local: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the {{key}} key from the {{row}} JSON row for this instance, or set it back to {{prompt}}. Unset and {{prompt2}} both mean no default has been chosen yet.
Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.
Welcome to Paperclip. Set up your first: Welcome to Paperclip. Set up your first company and agent to get started.
Create or select a company to view the d: Create or select a company to view the dashboard.

Sets the hue for the company icon. Leave: Sets the hue for the company icon. Leave empty for auto-generated color.

Require board approval for new hires: Require board approval for new hires
New agent hires stay pending until appro: New agent hires stay pending until approved by board.
Archive this company to hide it from the: Archive this company to hide it from the sidebar. This persists in the database.

Sending this comment will wake {{name}}: Sending this comment will wake {{name}} for triage while the subtree remains paused.
Assign an agent to wake them for triage: Assign an agent to wake them for triage while the subtree remains paused.
This issue's isolated workspace was arch: This issue's isolated workspace was archived. Your next comment or resume reopens it and rebuilds the worktree.
Title: Title
Group these {{items}} into folders to ke: Group these {{items}} into folders to keep things tidy.
Not attached to any Paperclip-run agent. Attaching is for agents Paperclip runs itself (adapter skill sync); terminal agents read this skill directly over the API/CLI and never need attaching.
Choose which task columns stay visible: Choose which task columns stay visible
Task state chip on the left edge.
Board user or agent who created the task: Board user or agent who created the task.
Linked project pill with its color.
Execution or project workspace used for: Execution or project workspace used for the task.
Opt into features that are still being e: 在成为默认行为之前，抢先试用仍在评估中的功能。
Experimental features may break at any t: 实验功能随时可能出问题。
These features are opt-in and come with: 这些功能为 opt-in，无兼容性保证，可能随时变更、损坏或移除。不要用于关键或生产流程。
Show the Apps navigation and allow acces: 显示应用导航，允许访问应用连接、网关与高级应用工具。
Let the heartbeat scheduler create recov: 让心跳调度器在配置的回溯窗口内，为任务依赖链创建恢复任务。
Lookback hours must be a whole number fr: 回溯小时数必须是 1 到 720 的整数。
Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle: 空闲时自动重启开发服务器
In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued: 在 `pnpm dev:once` 下，等所有排队和运行中的本地 agent 跑完。若后端变更或迁移使当前启动过期，自动重启服务器。
Allow agents to pin beta releases of the: 允许 agent 固定 Paperclip 核心技能的 beta 版本。关闭后所有 agent 回到默认 live 技能，已保存的固定不删除。
Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent su: 显示 Paperclip 管理的内置 agent 界面，包括内置名册徽章、内置 agent 标签页和设置控件。
Durable work products (blog posts, tweet: 任务创建并迭代的持久工作产物（博客、推文串等）。添加 Cases 标签页和 agent 案例 API。
Turning Cases off hides the tab and bloc: 关闭 Cases 会隐藏标签页并阻断案例 API。已有数据保留。
Restores the previous task detail page:: 恢复旧版任务详情页：页级 header 内联编辑描述、纯评论线程、固定 Properties 侧栏。仅聊天功能（流式活动折叠、内联 plan 与问题卡、三模式输入框）在经典视图不可用。
Switching takes effect immediately. No t: 切换立即生效。不影响任务数据。
Adds a Conference Room — one chat where: 添加会议室——你和全队在一个聊天里协作——以及实时活动流和重新设计的 onboarding，并把任务线程改成聊天气泡。随时可关回经典 UI。
Show the Decisions item in the main side: 在主侧边栏显示 Decisions 项——呈现等你输入任务的注意力首页。界面仍在评估中。
Show environment management in company s: 在公司设置中显示环境管理，允许项目和 agent 的环境分配控件。
Detect external URLs in issues and show: 检测 issue 中的外部 URL，显示 PR、工单等被引用工作对象的解析状态。
Show execution workspace controls in pro: 在项目配置中显示执行工作区控件，允许新旧任务运行使用隔离工作区行为。
Show task detail controls for browsing a: 在任务详情页显示浏览和预览任务相关 workspace 文件的控件。
Restore the Goals item in the main sideb: 在 goals 界面评估期间，恢复主侧边栏的 Goals 项。
Hide the local environment and run all a: 隐藏本地环境，所有 agent 跑在平台托管环境中。
Run tasks in this worktree: 在此 worktree 运行任务
This is an isolated git-worktree preview: 这是隔离的 git-worktree 预览实例。开启后调度器在这里执行运行。只有开启后创建的任务会自动运行，复制/已有任务保持停放。开关一次会重置 cutoff。
Execution is suppressed — effectively of: 执行被抑制——实际等于关闭。
This setting was armed in a different in: 该设置在其他实例激活并复制到这里，任务不会自动运行。
This setting is missing its activation c: 该设置缺少激活 cutoff，任务不会自动运行。
Toggle it off and back on to arm executi: 关掉再打开，可为这里创建的任务激活执行。
Show a \"Server\" section in the account: 在账户抽屉显示 Server 区块，含当前服务器重启时间和运行 commit。
Instruct agents to write user interactio: 指示 agent 用 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语写用户交互（plan 确认、提问、建议任务、复选框提示），并简述决策所需信息和各选项的后果。
Add a \"Smoke Lab\" tab under Apps → Dev: 在 Apps → Developer 下添加 Smoke Lab 标签页，并在仪表盘添加 Integration smoke 卡，用确定性本地 fixture（假 OAuth 提供方 + 回环 MCP 服务器）演练所有集成路径。仅私有部署。
Enable the experimental shared status-ca: 启用实验性共享状态卡看板及其带门禁的 API。关闭时已有卡数据保留。
Enabling Status Cards also enables Summa: 启用 Status Cards 会同时启用 Summaries。
Show Summarizer-generated status slots o: 在项目和工作区页面显示 Summarizer 生成的状态槽，支持按需刷新和修订历史。关闭时已有摘要数据保留。
Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabli: Status Cards 依赖 Summaries。关闭 Summaries 会同时关闭 Status Cards。
Task Plan Decomposition Panel: 任务 Plan 拆解面板
Show accepted-plan decomposition history: 在任务详情页显示已接受 plan 的拆解历史，用于在呈现方式打磨期间调试验证子任务创建行为。
Show task detail controls for configurin: 在任务详情页显示配置 watchdog agent 的控件，用于验证已停止的任务子树并在工作应继续时恢复活路径。
Checking recovery candidates before enab: 启用前正在检查恢复候选。
No recovery tasks would be created right: 当前不会创建恢复任务。自动恢复仍会对该窗口内未来的 liveness 事件生效。
